changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant model mentions and normalized naming. Added 'Chain-of-Thought Reasoning' as a specific task since the paper focuses on generating reasoning chains. Removed overly descriptive output text and simplified to core outputs.
Normalized metric names to standard forms. 'EM' is the same as 'Exact Match' so consolidated. All metrics are used to evaluate generated outputs.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs were only used for generation, not for evaluation.

changes_made.explanation: Simplified and normalized the guideline and criteria descriptions. Factual error checking is part of factuality evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on natural language generation through chain-of-thought reasoning for multi-step question answering. It uses both automatic metrics (Recall, F1, EM) and human evaluation (factuality checking). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and simplification of output descriptions.
